sources.title: 心一堂2016《紫微斗數捷覽》影印卷首印页10–17
sources.provider: Sanmin publisher-supplied public preview of Heart-One facsimile
sources.quality_notes: Eight previews were visually screened; pp10–12 show the juan-one title, Wang Luochuan imprint, opening method and star diagrams. Same 2016 edition as the earlier NCC preview; the 1581 date is catalog-derived and no shelfmark or dated imprint is visible in this sample.

sources.title: 金勉秀《명리원전 『子平三命通變淵源』 연구》图10
sources.provider: Dongbang Culture University dCollection, public deposit
sources.quality_notes: The PDF reproduces the NLK-attributed cover and preface opening. The remainder of the preface and the postface are reported transcriptions; exact full shelfmark, imprint and original dates are unverified. Figure 2 repeats the same preface image object.

sources.title: 2023首尔《明通賦／子平三命通變淵源》韩译合刊
sources.provider: National Assembly Library of Korea; publisher blurb supplied through Aladin
sources.quality_notes: Institutional catalog records translator 이명재, publisher 푸른길, 128 pages and two translated titles. The displayed publisher blurb reports use of the Kyujanggak manuscript and its marginal corrections. It does not establish the exact manuscript item or date.

remaining_lineage_questions: Verify the Shanghai Jielan copy against a holding-identifiable, dated imprint and distinguish the old print from later reproductions and opening similarities.
Confirm the complete NLK call number and the preface and postface endings; compare the undated physical holding with the Joseon print order, board records and titled parallel witnesses.
Bind the Kyujanggak manuscript behind the reported 2023 translation and compare its marginalia with the undated NLK print.
